summary: Recent discussions in the Iceberg community have focused on enhancing the REST Catalog specification, particularly with proposals for file-level access delegation and fine-grained read restrictions. Additionally, ongoing reviews of metadata specifications and new approaches to spatial data management have been highlighted.
highlights: Proposal for file-level access delegation in the Iceberg REST Catalog Spec
Introduction of fine-grained read restrictions in loadTable response
Discussion on handling existing statistics files in Iceberg
Proposal for QuadTree-inspired physical spatial partitioning
